summary_rationale: Marine Electricals (India) Ltd. combines a defensible Indian Navy/Coast Guard electrical qualification moat with surging hyperscale data center Power Train Unit order inflows (₹3,514 Cr total backlog as of Sep 30, 2026, 87.2% Industry/Data Centres, plus ₹233.21 Cr in Nov 16, 2026 wins from STT Global Data Centres and Ganges Shipyard; [ICRA]A- rating; 18.0% ROCE). However, it remains firmly cyclical-conditional on cash conversion, contract structure, and governance: 10-year cumulative CFO/PAT is 44.5% (₹93 Cr CFO vs ₹209 Cr PAT) with -₹48 Cr cumulative FCF, Debtor Days stand at 178 days (NWC/OI ~35%), most contracts are fixed-price without audited Data Centre segment breakouts, and footnote forensics highlight unresolved contingencies (₹31.36 Cr solar EPC arbitration payout exposure, ₹14.88 Cr GST demand under appeal, ~₹16 Cr IBC claim), consolidated audit exceptions (Eltech going concern, audit-trail gaps, unimpaired Xanatos goodwill), repeated equity dilution plus a 3.01% promoter stake sale in Sep 2026, and related-party subsidiary transfers (June 2026 sale of 70% of MEL Shipyard to promoters for ₹70,000 alongside loss-making Evigo Charge funding).
